 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

  Outdoor Fitness Facility, Building 389— Supply, Delivery, and Limited Installation Support  

  Notice Type:  Sources Sought / Market Research 
 Notice Number:  HARBSS-2027-01 
 Contracting Office:  482d CONF/PK 
 Location of Performance:  Homestead Air Reserve Base, Florida 
 Response Due Date/Time:  November 26, 2026, 5:00 PM EST 
 Response Submission:  Nika Salemi, nika.salemi.2@us.af.mil 
 Proposed NAICS Code:  236220, Commercial and Institutional Building Construction 
 Proposed Product Service Code (PSC):  5670 Building Components, Prefabricated 

  1. Notice Purpose  

 THIS IS A  SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE  ISSUED FOR MARKET-RESEARCH AND PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY. THIS NOTICE IS  NOT  A SOLICITATION, REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL, REQUEST FOR QUOTATION, INVITATION FOR BID, OR COMMITMENT BY THE GOVERNMENT TO AWARD A CONTRACT. 

 The 482d Contracting Flight, Homestead Air Reserve Base (HARB), FL, seeks information from capable commercial sources, including all small-business socioeconomic categories, to determine the availability and capability of firms that can perform the requirement described in Attachment 1 KYJM19-9003 Outdoor Fitness SOW, Red Horse Project, 12 Nov 2026. Responses will be used to support acquisition planning, including consideration of the appropriate contract type, acquisition approach, and potential small-business set-aside strategy. 

 The Government will not reimburse respondents for any costs associated with preparation or submission of information in response to this notice. A response to this notice is not required to respond to a future solicitation, if issued. Any future solicitation will be announced separately. 

  

  2. Requirement Overview  

 The 482d Contracting Flight, Homestead Air Reserve Base (HARB), FL is conducting market research for the  Outdoor Fitness Facility, Building 389  project at Homestead Air Reserve Base (HARB), Florida. 

 The anticipated requirement is primarily for the  procurement, delivery, and associated submittals for construction materials and equipment  required to support construction of an outdoor fitness facility. Air Force RED HORSE personnel will perform the majority of construction and installation activities. Contractor installation responsibilities are limited principally to the steel picket fence and, if applicable, a separate lightning-protection system. 

 The contractor would be expected to: 

 
	 Procure and deliver all materials identified in the Government-furnished bill of materials (BOM), Attachment 2 Outdoor Fitness Facility, BOM Template. 
	 Furnish the Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) package, including engineered shop drawings and all associated structure materials. 
	 Coordinate concrete-truck deliveries to support Government construction execution. 
	 Furnish the specified construction equipment for the required durations, fueled and ready for operation at the work site. 
	 Install a new steel picket fence, including site restoration for areas disturbed by fence installation. 
	 Install a lightning-protection system if the proposed PEB cannot include a compliant built-in lightning-protection system. 
 

 The provided BOM identifies, among other materials and equipment, rubber fitness flooring, concrete masonry materials, electrical distribution materials, outdoor fans, motion-activated lighting, concrete, base course, PEB-related items, and construction-equipment rentals. 

  

  3. Anticipated Scope  

  3.1 Material Procurement and Delivery  

 The contractor shall be capable of procuring, delivering, and warranting the materials and equipment identified in the Government-furnished BOM. The contractor shall provide required material and equipment submittals before ordering materials, and the Government will approve final submittals in writing before purchase. 

 Anticipated submittals include: 

 
	 Steel picket fence; 
	 PEB signed and sealed shop drawings; 
	 Outdoor ceiling fans; 
	 Lighting; 
	 Smart meter; 
	 Electrical panel; 
	 Fitness flooring; 
	 Bird netting; 
	 Material warranty plan, including roof, flooring, and other applicable equipment warranties; and 
	 Fence material and labor warranty. 
 

  3.2 Pre-Engineered Building Package  

 The contractor shall be capable of providing a complete PEB material package based on Government design drawings, including digitally signed and sealed shop drawings prepared by a Professional Engineer. 

 The PEB package is expected to include, at a minimum: 

 
	 Lifting-rack/support beams; 
	 A fixed steel beam with predrilled holes for 25-foot ropes; 
	 Toe-hold bars located three inches above the finished floor; 
	 Factory coating and painting, with Government-selected colors; 
	 Medium-bronze exterior roof panels and manufacturer-standard light interior roof panels; 
	 Standing seam metal roofing; 
	 Gutters and downspouts; 
	 Built-in copper lightning protection, where available; and 
	 Black, heavy-duty polyethylene bird netting with ¾-inch mesh meeting or exceeding the specified mesh-quality and break-strength requirements. 
 

 The PEB shall be designed in accordance with the SOW’s specified structural and high-velocity-wind requirements. The SOW requires a minimum 20-year material warranty, a current Miami-Dade Notice of Acceptance for the PEB and insulation, and a roof assembly capable of the stated uplift and wind criteria. Zinc-plated metal is prohibited. 

  3.3 Lightning Protection System — Conditional Installation  

 If a compliant PEB with built-in lightning protection is unavailable, the contractor shall be capable of furnishing and installing a conventional lightning-protection and grounding system following completion of RED HORSE construction activities.
